name: finchain-sepolia
conclusions: OG: the identity on chain is the contract account 0x9F7647013499C44B7E0432F5E9e22E4Afd447aD1; the key 0x5Fee42D697975f6154164b29371c1c447F56fb4E is its owner and operator. A transaction the key sends by itself comes from 0x5Fee42D697975f6154164b29371c1c447F56fb4E: the ledger would record that address as the worker of an audit job, not the account. The account is the sender only of calls made through its execute.

cell-b: the identity on chain is the contract account 0x2Dd0c30383EcD6414e0b9DD6F10bf27BFe8715BB; the key 0x7dCE041276791F2371EA2e77F99119f22D32cd81 is its owner and operator. A transaction the key sends by itself comes from 0x7dCE041276791F2371EA2e77F99119f22D32cd81: the ledger would record that address as the worker of an audit job, not the account. The account is the sender only of calls made through its execute.

tender 5 is owned by 0x9F7647013499C44B7E0432F5E9e22E4Afd447aD1 (the account of OG): the adapter accepts its confirmation from that address only, and that address is a contract - a key sending by itself is refused (NotDemander).
tender 5, submission 1 (accepted, settled by a verifier) was delivered by 0x2Dd0c30383EcD6414e0b9DD6F10bf27BFe8715BB (the account of cell-b): that is the worker a receipt would name.
tender 5 is judged by 0xb90d0a7Bb619255C0f8fa796DbBA2421abbd96De (the World's hashlock verifier).

Here the agents' identities are contract accounts and the keys are other addresses. Taking part with keys alone is an operator-wallet integration; it is not the agents taking part as themselves, and the two are to be accepted separately.
source: The addresses and the tender are those of the two-agent business loop recorded on 2026-11-13 in the finchain repository (manifests/evidence/business-loop-2026-11-13.json, og-finchain-2026-11-13.json): the OG minted tender 5 through its account, cell-b delivered through its account, a hashlock verifier settled it.
This file holds public addresses only. The check reads the chain and compares; it does not rely on the recorded description.
